title: Changelog
text: Added mad_qc_bulk() mad_qc_sc() explicit bulk single-cell observation-level wrappers backed compact flags, thresholds, settings results. Added default log1p calculation, partial "none" overrides, raw-scale inverse thresholds, concise cli summaries, deterministic playful grades, optional interactive ASCII startup banner. Added coverage invalid metrics, transformations, matrices, grouped zero-MAD calculations, three-valued flags, collisions, Seurat preservation, CLI output, banner helper.

title: Changelog
text: Bumped package version 0.4.0 added cli Imports. wrapper metrics mandatory explicit; input class, column name, regular expression, numeric type triggers metric selection. Single-cell annotation adds mad_qc_outlier; metric flags remain compact report. Neither wrapper filters observations. mad_qc_seurat() now requires explicit metrics remains documented compatibility path v0.3.2 long-report/per-metric annotation behavior. Rewrote README vignette around two-wrapper interface explicit scientific interpretation.

title: Changelog
text: Added mad_scale() single focused dense-matrix operation, using matrixStats row column medians MADs expression heatmap scaling. Added realistic deterministic bulk RNA-seq single-cell metadata examples.

title: Changelog
text: Reports mad_limits(), mad_qc(), summarize_mad_qc() valid tibbles; mad_qc reports retain calculation metadata auditing. Inactive directional limits NA_real_ rather Inf -Inf, outlier evaluation explicitly direction-aware. Observation summaries annotations use three-valued overall logic: TRUE failure, FALSE everything passed, NA nothing failed least one metric evaluated. plot_mad_qc() uses green, blue, orange status colors; missing values visible blue panel-floor triangles; threshold types use dark labeled lines. mad_qc_seurat() defaults report mode data-frame Seurat annotation protect existing flag columns unless overwrite = TRUE. Documentation now presents one assay-agnostic metadata-table model ungrouped QC universal default optional deliberate grouping.

title: Changelog
text: Removed sparse-matrix support Matrix sparseMatrixStats suggestions. Removed row_mad(), col_mad(), raw-MAD feature ranking top_mad_features(). Replaced broad robust_scale() API focused mad_scale(). Removed winsorize_mad(); veryMAD flags observations rather modifying measured values.

title: Changelog
text: summarize_mad_qc() deterministic metric-level observation-level summaries flags already present tidy QC report. plot_mad_qc() explicit distribution observation-index views grouped, finite threshold indicators optional ggplot2. Safe Matrix::dgCMatrix support row_mad(), col_mad(), top_mad_features() optional sparseMatrixStats methods.

title: Changelog
text: Reframed mad_qc() documentation around assay-agnostic observation metadata: bulk libraries, single cells, spatial observations remain ungrouped default, explicit group_by changes statistical reference distribution. mad_qc() reports now retain calculation-group compact observation-metadata attributes plots can distinguish saved threshold groups optional visual faceting. plot_mad_qc() now uses facet_by layout reads calculation groups report; ungrouped reports never acquire sample batch thresholds. top_mad_features() now explicitly preserves original feature order MAD values tied. ggplot2, Matrix, sparseMatrixStats optional suggested dependencies; dense workflows package installation require . robust_scale() continues reject sparse matrices clearer message: median centering can destroy sparsity, veryMAD never converts implicitly dense matrix.

title: Changelog
text: mad_limits() shared, auditable threshold foundation. col_mad() strictly column-oriented matrix MADs. annotate_mad_qc() index-safe metadata annotation. mad_qc_seurat() explicit SeuratObject reporting annotation. top_mad_features() deliberately limited raw marginal MAD ranking. focused QC vignette Linux R-release package-check workflow.

title: Changelog
text: mad_qc() now ordinary data-frame function long, stable, group-auditable results; multiple grouping columns missing group labels supported without dropping observations. Scores, thresholds, outliers, winsorization, robust scaling, grouped QC now share zero_mad = "zero", "na", "error" behavior. Transformations validated: log10 requires positive values log1p requires nonnegative values. row_mad() row-, col_mad() column-, robust_scale() uses margin = "rows" "columns". Runtime dependencies reduced matrixStats; SeuratObject optional.

title: Changelog
text: is_outlier() removed; use is_mad_outlier() nmads direction. winsorize() removed; use winsorize_mad(). select_variable_features() replaced top_mad_features(), ranks rows documents raw MAD mean-variance-aware. mad_qc(Seurat object) removed; use mad_qc_seurat() explicitly. S7 dispatch, dynamic method registration, .onLoad() hooks, progress bars, verbose, numeric matrix margins, direct Seurat slot manipulation removed.

title: Explicit observation-level QC with veryMAD
text: Rows observations columns metadata candidate QC metrics. Every metric direction user-selected; veryMAD never selects numeric columns, recognizes naming conventions, filters observations. compact report list containing flags, thresholds, settings.

title: Explicit observation-level QC with veryMAD
text: call accepts matrix whose rows observations. gene--sample expression matrix automatically QC table.
code: bulk <- data.frame(   library_size = c(1e6, 30e6, 32e6, 31e6, 33e6),   mapping_rate = c(.50, .92, .94, .93, .95),   batch = c("a", "a", "a", "b", "b"),   row.names = paste0("sample", 1:5) ) metrics <- c(library_size = "lower", mapping_rate = "lower") flagged <- mad_qc_bulk(bulk, metrics,   transform = c(mapping_rate = "none"), verbose = FALSE) report <- attr(flagged, "mad_qc") report$thresholds #> # A tibble: 2 × 14 #>   metric  direction transform n_observations n_evaluated n_missing median    mad #>   <chr>   <chr>     <chr>              <int>       <int>     <int>  <dbl>  <dbl> #> 1 librar… lower     log1p                  5           5         0  17.2  0.0486 #> 2 mappin… lower     none                   5           5         0   0.93 0.0148 #> # ℹ 6 more variables: lower <dbl>, upper <dbl>, lower_raw <dbl>, #> #   upper_raw <dbl>, n_outliers <int>, outlier_proportion <dbl> mad_qc_bulk(as.matrix(bulk[c("library_size", "mapping_rate")]), metrics,   transform = c(mapping_rate = "none"), verbose = FALSE) #>         library_size mapping_rate library_size_mad_outlier #> sample1      1.0e+06         0.50                     TRUE #> sample2      3.0e+07         0.92                    FALSE #> sample3      3.2e+07         0.94                    FALSE #> sample4      3.1e+07         0.93                    FALSE #> sample5      3.3e+07         0.95                    FALSE #>         mapping_rate_mad_outlier #> sample1                     TRUE #> sample2                    FALSE #> sample3                    FALSE #> sample4                    FALSE #> sample5                    FALSE

title: Robust MAD Scaling and Auditable Omics Quality Control
text: CLI grade playful presentation based proportion unique observations flagged: 0%, >0–5%, >5–15%, >15%. biological conclusion, acceptance criterion, claim laboratory failure, filtering recommendation. MAD thresholds adaptive heuristics, universal biological cutoffs. Upper-tail RNA count flags automatically doublet calls; doublet detection outside veryMAD. Current Bioconductor RNA-QC tools similarly use robust, metric-specific outlier rules, veryMAD deliberately leaves metric, direction, transformation, grouping, downstream action user control. See scrapper reference manual.

title: Flag observations with explicit MAD thresholds — mad_qc
text: Count-like QC metrics library size, total RNA counts, detected features often strongly right-skewed. cases, estimating MAD thresholds explicit log transformation log1p can give useful reference distribution. Bounded percentages, proportions, rates usually kept original scale log transform changes interpretation already bounded measurements. Transformations explicit per metric. transform = NULL equivalent identity transformation every metric, mad_qc() never infers transformation metric name. Thresholds, medians, MADs, value column expressed calculation scale. raw_value column always preserves exact input measurement scale. direction = "" flags tails selected metric, assign biological cause. example, upper-tail count feature flag means unusually high relative reference distribution; doublet call automatic filtering decision.
